### R-3 Durable backfill

From each persisted record's creation time and stored priority, calculate any missing due time. Default November 2026: the server runs a repeatable backfill before listening, even with the flag off, so operators can run once with the old API visible and then enable it. If persistence fails, startup fails and the old file remains available. Existing due values, ticket IDs, timestamps, statuses, audit, outbox and counters persist. Check the file during the initial boot and restart with different hours.
notes.entry_at_end:
### R-3 Durable backfill

From each persisted record's creation time and stored priority, calculate any missing due time. The November 2026 operator clarification requires a separate, repeatable command: stop the service and run `DATA_FILE=... npm run migrate:due`, then enable the feature. Starting the service never fills in existing deadlines. With the feature on and any due value absent, startup fails and names `npm run migrate:due`. A migration write failure leaves the old file available. Existing due values, ticket IDs, timestamps, statuses, audit, outbox and counters persist. Check the file around the migration and restart with different hours.

The offline command preserves all previously set due times, changes only missing deadlines, and reports the count. The migration test verifies identical bytes on a no-op repeat (W1/S1).

The startup test observes exit status 2 and the migration command when a deadline is missing. An omitted flag leaves existing deadlines hidden and does not fill missing ones (W1/S2).

## R-3 File migration and rollback

On startup, the single service writer fills missing deadlines from each stored ticket's created timestamp and current priority. It atomically persists a changed snapshot before listening, even with visibility off, and never updates already assigned values. Preserve version 1, identifiers, history, outbox and existing fields. Verify a legacy fixture, a restart with changed hours, and a real 1.4.0 startup on the candidate file with every ticket visible. Before a binary rollback, backup the enriched file because the old writer discards fields it cannot retain.
notes.entry_at_end:
### R-3 File migration and rollback

With the service stopped, operators run `npm run backfill:due-times` to fill missing deadlines from each stored ticket's created timestamp and current priority. The command atomically saves the changed snapshot and preserves already assigned values. Startup never fills deadlines. Enabled startup refuses a file containing any ticket without a deadline and names the command. Preserve version 1, identifiers, history, outbox and existing fields. Verify a legacy fixture, a restart with changed hours, and a real 1.4.0 startup on the candidate file with every ticket visible. Before a binary rollback, backup the enriched file because the old writer discards fields it cannot retain.
